portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 66 (Bell Street Terminal). Silver Whisper's single 2027 Seattle departure is a one-way, all-suite voyage to Vancouver.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: An unhurried sea day with butler service, the Zàgara Spa, and afternoon tea in the Panorama Lounge.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Creek Street, Saxman Native Village, and floatplane flightseeing over Misty Fjords National Monument.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: An afternoon and evening in Alaska's capital — Mendenhall Glacier, whale watching in Auke Bay, or a helicopter landing on the Juneau Icefield.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: Explore Russian-era landmarks, the Sitka National Historical Park totem trail, and the Fortress of the Bear.
portsOfCall.name: Sitka, AK

portsOfCall.description: A rare small-ship call on Prince of Wales Island — the Klawock Totem Park and a quiet glimpse of rural Alaska that big ships can't reach.
portsOfCall.name: Klawock, AK

portsOfCall.description: A final day of scenic cruising south through British Columbia's coastal waters.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage

portsOfCall.description: Disembarkation in Vancouver — this voyage ends in Canada, not Seattle.
portsOfCall.name: Vancouver, BC
